news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Triple Threat Series Including Memory ETF Featuring SanDisk
news.summary: Tradr ETFs announced the upcoming launch of a new 'Triple Threat' series of leveraged ETFs, which includes a fund providing 200% daily exposure to a basket of memory stocks, including SanDisk Corporation.

news.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
news.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

news.headline: Micron Reports High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Capacity Largely Booked for Upcoming Year
news.summary: Micron Technology, Inc. has indicated that the majority of its High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) production capacity for the next year is already committed to customers.

news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Upcoming Launch of Leveraged ETF Featuring Micron Technology, Inc.
news.summary: Tradr ETFs announced plans to launch the "Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Memory Daily ETF" on December 2, 2026, which will provide leveraged exposure to Micron Technology, Inc. and other memory sector stocks.

news.headline: Micron Discloses Increased Executive Security Expenses
news.summary: Micron Technology's latest proxy filing reveals a significant increase in security spending for CEO Sanjay Mehrotra.

news.headline: NVIDIA Faces New U.S. Export Controls and Regional Market Shifts
news.summary: New U.S. government export rules require licenses for advanced AI chip sales to data center operators in several Southeast Asian countries and Brazil, impacting NVIDIA's regional operations.

news.headline: NVIDIA and Kioxia Announce Collaboration to Extend GPU Memory Capacity
news.summary: NVIDIA and Kioxia America have announced a collaboration to demonstrate the potential to extend effective GPU memory capacity to petabyte scale.

news.headline: NVIDIA Orders Partners to Stop Server Shipments to ASEAN States
news.summary: NVIDIA has directed its partners to halt server shipments to countries within the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
